title: The Vessel That Remembers Rain
prompt: A singular celadon tea vessel suspended above a rain-dark stone basin in an open mountain tea room at blue hour; one fine gold repair seam catches the last light, wind lifts a translucent paper screen, distant cloud and pine reflected in the water, intimate human scale, quiet tension between fracture and continuance, authored fine-art cinematic still, tactile ceramic glaze and wet stone, no decorative clutter.
composition: off-centre vessel, low eye line, generous negative space, reflected axis broken by the gold seam, 4:5 portrait crop
lighting: blue-hour ambient field, narrow warm rim on the repair seam, soft cloud fill, restrained wet-surface reflections

decision.rule: Gemma/Qwen decide only from the recorded prompt, DINO observation, Pixtral critique, and image receipt. No silent promotion.
